h1: Grandview Ladprao Hotel — Affordable Budget Stay in Soi Ladprao 15 with Free Parking Near Central Ladprao
intro: If you need an affordable place to stay in the Central Ladprao–Ha Yaek Ladprao area with free parking and convenient access to Bangkok's rail network, Grandview Ladprao Hotel delivers the essentials at a price that is hard to match in this neighbourhood. The small 14-room, 3-star property sits at Soi Ladprao 15 — roughly 870 m from MRT Lat Phrao, five minutes by taxi to Central Plaza Ladprao and Union Mall, with a 7-Eleven conveniently on the ground floor of the same building. Rooms start from approximately ฿600–฿750/night. Guest score: 7.0 out of 10 from 195 reviews.

body.html: Soi Ladprao 15 sits in the Chatuchak district on the eastern fringe of the Central Ladprao shopping zone. Step out of the soi and you are within easy reach of two of Bangkok's biggest retail destinations — Central Plaza Ladprao and Union Mall — while MRT Lat Phrao puts the Blue Line at your disposal. Grandview Ladprao Hotel is a compact guesthouse-style property that has carved a niche by offering free parking, a 7-Eleven on the premises, and sub-฿1,000 nightly rates that are genuinely rare this close to Ha Yaek Ladprao.

The hotel has 14 rooms across two categories: a Standard Double of 25 sq m and a Suite of 45 sq m. The Suite is frequently called out in positive reviews as surprisingly spacious for the price, with a separate sitting area that works well for those who need a temporary workspace. All rooms include air conditioning, a refrigerator, free Wi-Fi, and an en-suite bathroom. Some rooms open onto a small balcony.
"Clean room, great location — 7-Eleven right downstairs, Big C a short walk away. Price is unbeatable for the area. Perfect for a short business trip."

What guests consistently praise is the neighbourhood convenience. The in-building 7-Eleven handles late-night snack or toiletry needs without stepping outside. Big C Ladprao is a short walk, and a cluster of local restaurants lines the surrounding streets. For transit, MRT Lat Phrao is 870 m away — about 11 minutes on foot on a comfortable day, though in Bangkok's midday heat most guests prefer a quick Grab ride. The hotel also provides free parking, a genuine differentiator in a neighbourhood where dedicated parking is scarce.

The honest picture from guest reviews is more nuanced than the location score alone suggests. This property operates on a self-service model with no 24-hour front desk. Guests must contact the hotel via LINE at least 24 hours before arrival to arrange check-in. Multiple reviews flag inconsistent air-conditioning performance — a few guests described rooms that stayed warm despite the unit running — and others noted worn bed linen and towels. Several reviews also mention pest sightings, which helps explain the property's 7.0 overall score rather than something higher.

With a location sub-score of 7.9 — the highest category across Trip.com's breakdown — the hotel's greatest strength is clearly its position, not its facilities or service. For travellers visiting Bangkok to shop at Central Ladprao or Union Mall, attend meetings in the Chatuchak corridor, or simply needing a well-priced stopover with free parking, Grandview Ladprao Hotel delivers on what it promises. Those prioritising consistent cleanliness and round-the-clock hotel support would be better served by one of the other properties in this neighbourhood guide.

Rates start from approximately ฿600–฿750/night for a Standard Double — at a time when comparable rooms in the area regularly push past ฿1,000. That price gap explains why many of the positive reviews come from guests who understood the trade-off going in: bare-bones service, good location, very low cost. Read recent reviews before booking and communicate your check-in time in advance — and the stay is likely to match expectations.

The location score is genuine — the neighbourhood is practical and well-connected. However, guests seeking consistent cleanliness and round-the-clock reception should look at higher-rated alternatives in the same area.

tips.title: Contact via LINE Before Arrival
tips.body: There is no 24-hour front desk. You must message the hotel on LINE at least 24 hours before check-in to arrange key handover or entry codes. Failing to do this can mean a locked door on arrival.

tips.title: Confirm Parking When You Book
tips.body: Free parking is available but limited. Mention your vehicle at the time of booking and again in your pre-arrival LINE message to secure a space — especially on weekends when street parking fills quickly.

tips.title: Use the Ground-Floor 7-Eleven
tips.body: The in-building convenience store is open 24 hours. Stock up on breakfast, snacks and drinks here — it saves a trip out and is especially useful if you arrive late at night.

tips.title: Grab Beats Walking in the Heat
tips.body: MRT Lat Phrao is 870 m away — walkable in cool weather, but Bangkok's midday sun makes the 11-minute walk uncomfortable. A Grab from the hotel entrance is cheap and arrives quickly.
